ObjectName.value: 108251 el basha hammam in acre PikiWiki Israel

Categories.value: Hammam al-Pasha, Acre|Images from the Pikiwiki project

ImageDescription.value:
Name: El Basha Hammam in Acre
Description: One of the oldest hammam complexes in the country, established in 1795 by Ahmed Al Jazar, the Ottoman Pasha. There is an opinion that there was also a crusader bathhouse on the site, the remains of which the current hammam was built. The hamam served as a social meeting place for senior officials in the Ottoman government and functioned as a hamam until the establishment of the state
